Inclusion Criteria:
  -  The reproductive age of the woman
  -  Blood reflux in the parametric, [OR]  uterine, [OR]  gonadal veins
  -  The absence  [AND] of any concomitant pathology, accompanied by chronic pelvic pain
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  The absence of blood reflux in in the parametric, [OR]  uterine, [OR]  gonadal veins
  -  The presence of diseases, the clinical course of which suggests the presence of chronic pelvic pain  [AND] and other varieties of chronic pain, including migraine
  -  Pregnancy
